I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble using our online system. The system has been in place for 2 years now and the majority of feedback we receive from patients is overwhelmingly positive. If you're struggling to use it, and this applies to all patients, you can still call through to Reception who will complete the form on your behalf. The system is there to enable us to triage requests - just like they do via 111, 999 and in A&E - to ensure that patients see the right person at the right time. We have a broad spectrum of reasons why patients request appointments - some are more urgent than others, and we have to find a way to prioritise the requests coming in so that patients can get the care that is needed. The government are also pushing a "analogue to digital" focus for the whole of the NHS. We are aware of patients who struggle to use technology and we make adjustments for those patients - from hosting workshops where our staff will teach them how to use the systems, to allowing patients to still call and speak to a member of the Reception team who can take the information on their behalf. We are sad to see patients give us low ratings on Google rather than speak to us directly to see how we can help you with your access. I'd be happy to speak to you individually to talk through your experience and take any feedback on how we could improve things.
